report.scope: native controller straight/junction fixture at speed30/obeySpeedLimit true; not task-layout performance or universal travel-time fit
report.external_validity: Same core/vehicle/contracts as recorded competition; custom empty straight roads lack competition curves, speed-zone transitions, objects and complex entry paths. Historical118-row task diagnosis remains unchanged.

frozen_grouping_policy.grouping: current-round trajectories determine the current denominator; v28r1 groups are a separate conservative comparison
frozen_grouping_policy.start: observe immediately preceding first nonempty WM frame; otherwise first red detection
frozen_grouping_policy.end: before delivery_phase_start; delivery outcomes remain separately reported
frozen_grouping_policy.normalization: remove absolute ticks, map/package/track IDs, blue detections, pre-confirmation patrol; robot/WM positions relative to first retained observation
frozen_grouping_policy.comparison: same target-event order and categorical fields; complete-link groups (every member pair must match)
frozen_grouping_policy.success: all group members confirmed AND grabbed the WM-associated real target; mixed outcomes fail
frozen_grouping_policy.stationary_repeat: consecutive actual observe calls at the same tick, or pose displacement <5cm AND heading change <10deg; prefer exact logged odometry, fallback to driver truth samples
frozen_grouping_policy.blocked_motion_guard: observe_motion_violation is a failed attempted observation; it fails its run and the guard gate even though the actual observe was prevented
frozen_grouping_policy.fixed_rule_gates: no run may fail a fixed rule; every confirmed-and-grabbed run must pass every fixed rule; unreached-phase unknowns on unsuccessful runs remain unknown
frozen_grouping_policy.truth_association: WM-to-truth distance <=30cm; no raw-detection or nearest-only fallback labels
frozen_grouping_policy.two_ball_extension: selected-target fragments for both ball slots; explicit boundaries; same tolerances/complete-link; never only first ball

scope: stage2: >=8/10 dual deliveries, >=8/10 optimal first choices, successful-run median <=300s; independent scenes also reported without an invented extra rate gate
